community_sources.title: Apple Developer Forums: review rejections for face photo / AI
community_sources.signal: Reviewers requested exact face-data collection, use, storage, retention, deletion, third-party sharing, and policy wording; screenshots and business model were also questioned.
community_sources.use: Add evidence requests and reviewer-note tests; do not turn forum questions into policy.

community_sources.title: Apple Developer Forums: third-party AI disclosure/consent reports
community_sources.signal: Developers report rejections where the pre-transmission disclosure did not explain what data was shared or identify the third-party AI recipient.
community_sources.use: Conservative informed-consent test tied to the official privacy rule.

community_sources.title: Reddit: repeated Guideline 4.2.2 rejection
community_sources.signal: A developer reports repeated minimum-functionality rejection for an app Apple characterized as links/images/aggregated internet content.
community_sources.use: Trigger native-value dossier and a manual 4.2 review.

community_sources.title: Reddit: WebView and native-value lessons
community_sources.signal: Community advice emphasizes functionality beyond a website wrapper.
community_sources.use: Heuristic only; evaluate against Guidelines 4.2 and 4.3.

community_sources.title: X: developer commentary on third-party AI opt-in
community_sources.signal: Commentary says AI features should remain disabled after consent is declined and reports missing consent screens as a rejection pattern.
community_sources.use: Test denial-state coherence; never use as authority.

community_sources.title: X: IAP and submission hygiene reports
community_sources.signal: Reported rejection reasons include IAP products not submitted and unclear subscription benefits.
community_sources.use: Add deterministic evidence checks tied to official IAP rules.

community_sources.title: X: thin AI wrapper and Guideline 4.3 commentary
community_sources.signal: Developer commentary describes one-screen prompt forwarders and generic AI concepts as recurring 4.3/spam risks and recommends substantial workflows, differentiation, and offline value.
community_sources.use: Trigger native-value and sibling/template comparison; profile URL only because the supplied compilation did not include the exact post URL. Do not treat suggested product features as an approval formula.

community_sources.title: X: release completeness and reviewer-path rejection reports
community_sources.signal: A developer compilation reports ATT, subscription metadata, duplicated promotional images, permission pre-prompts, premium review state, HealthKit presentation, naming, restore, terms, screenshot, placeholder, and broken-flow problems.
community_sources.use: Expand clean-install, metadata, paywall, permission, and production-flag checks; profile URL only because exact post URLs were not supplied.

community_sources.title: X: Guideline 2.1 screen-recording and information-request reports
community_sources.signal: Developers report requests for a physical-device recording, tested device/OS list, external services, IAP flow, feature purpose, and access instructions on new submissions.
community_sources.use: Prepare an evidence package for difficult-to-reproduce apps; profile URL only because the exact post URL was not supplied. Do not claim a universal video requirement.

community_sources.title: X: generative-content removal and off-store promotion report
community_sources.signal: A developer report links app removal to nudification or explicit generative behavior promoted outside the store but not candidly represented during review.
community_sources.use: Test worst reachable output and reconcile ads/social promotion with the binary, metadata, age rating, filters, and review notes; profile URL only because the exact post URL was not supplied.

community_sources.title: X: open-source App Store Preflight tool announcement
community_sources.signal: The author claims checks for privacy manifests, unused entitlements, competitor terms, subscription pricing, app-type branches, and China-specific AI terminology.
community_sources.use: Compare product-pattern coverage only. Do not adopt a storefront blacklist or guideline claim without the tool source and current official authority.

community_sources.title: X: Rork AI App Store Reviewer launch claims
community_sources.signal: Vendor commentary cites submission/rejection statistics, performance-related rejection prevalence, and an internal reviewer benchmark.
community_sources.use: Treat all percentages and accuracy claims as commercial marketing until an independently reproducible dataset and protocol are available.

community_sources.title: Ionic Forum: Capacitor privacy-manifest submission reports
community_sources.signal: Developers report manifest problems becoming visible during full submission despite earlier development or TestFlight success.
community_sources.use: Trigger final-archive and embedded-SDK manifest inspection; never treat TestFlight success as submission proof.

community_sources.title: Capacitor issue: external website as primary WebView
community_sources.signal: Maintainer discussion discourages an external site as the production Capacitor origin and notes possible store-review risk.
community_sources.use: Operational context for final server.url/origin inspection; Apple policy and final app evidence control.

community_sources.title: Capacitor issue: nested framework and duplicate identifier in a 9 alpha
community_sources.signal: An issue reports upload validation failure from nested frameworks and duplicate bundle identifiers and describes 8.5.0 as unaffected.
community_sources.use: Trigger framework-neutral final-bundle invariants; do not turn an alpha defect into a warning against Capacitor 8.5.

community_sources.title: Apple Developer Forums: August 2026 review delays
community_sources.signal: Multiple developers reported prolonged Waiting for Review periods in August 2026.
community_sources.use: Operational planning only; never score compliance or invent expected review times.
